items.title: Booking (BKNG) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of online travel agency Booking Holdings (NASDAQ:BKNG) fell 4.8% in the afternoon session after the European General Court upheld an EU antitrust decision blocking its planned 1.63 billion euro acquisition of ETraveli Group, according to Tipranks.
